# Dr. Samuel Mbote

> Physician (MBChB, Kampala International University; MCS, COSECSA general surgery) and AI/software engineer. IBM-certified AI engineer and full-stack software developer. Works on bioinformatics and NGS pipelines, clinical genomics, LLM and AI-agent evaluation, and trustworthy healthcare AI for low-resource settings. Founder, Daktari Genomed Labs. Open to remote roles and contracts in bioinformatics, AI evaluation, data science and annotation, biomedical research and scientific writing.

## Projects (all MIT-licensed, on GitHub)

- [NGS Variant Pipeline](https://github.com/mbote-droid/ngs-variant-pipeline): Nextflow pipeline from raw reads to an evidence-cited clinical variant report. Germline, somatic (Mutect2), cohort joint genotyping and long-read (minimap2, Clair3, Sniffles2); GIAB accuracy benchmarking; HL7 FHIR output; 164 tests.
- [Precision Onco Africa](https://github.com/mbote-droid/precision-onco-africa): offline-capable multi-agent LLM platform for TP53 variant interpretation. 26 specialist agents including a 6-agent tumour board, an AI reasoning-audit layer (hallucination, citation quality), ClinVar/IARC benchmark (7/7 known pathogenic hotspots correct), runs on 8 GB RAM; 566 tests.
- [NeuroSonix](https://github.com/mbote-droid/Neurosonix): audio annotation and multi-agent evaluation of voice-agent conversations across five quality dimensions; FastAPI + React; 133 tests.
- [CDISC Clinical Trial Safety Dashboard](https://github.com/mbote-droid/CDISC-SAFETY-DASHBOARD): raw EDC data to CDISC SDTM (DM, AE, LB) and ADaM (ADSL, ADAE, ADLB), data-quality quarantine, conformance checks, TEAE and SOC/PT tables, risk differences with Newcombe CIs, lab shift tables, eDISH/Hy's law screen, SAS XPT v5 export; 70 tests.
- [BioEvidence Forge](https://github.com/mbote-droid/BioEvidence-Forge): self-hosted PubMed evidence monitor with a provenance-preserving SQLite archive, transparent scoring and Markdown evidence briefs; FastAPI; 146 tests.
- [Healthcare AI Radar](https://github.com/mbote-droid/healthcare-ai-radar): healthcare-AI literature intelligence with a transparent 0-100 Scoop Score and a five-layer anti-hallucination guardrail; 90 tests.
- [TP53 Bioinformatics Pipeline](https://github.com/mbote-droid/tp53_analysis): sequence retrieval, ORF discovery, phylogenetics, InterPro domain annotation and a cancer-mutation heatmap; 63 tests.

## Science and methods

- Computational neuroscience: Hodgkin–Huxley and integrate-and-fire models, phase-plane analysis, Poisson spike statistics, spike-triggered average and LNP encoding models, Bayesian decoding, entropy and mutual information, Hebbian/STDP plasticity, TD reinforcement learning.
- Biomedical imaging and medical physics: MRI k-space and 2D FFT reconstruction, Bloch equations (T1/T2), CT via the Radon transform and filtered back-projection, Beer–Lambert attenuation, ultrasound and nuclear imaging physics, PSF/MTF/SNR.
- Signal processing: FFT/inverse FFT, Welch PSD, convolution theorem, Butterworth/SOS filters, wavelets, Laplace and z-transforms, ECG and HRV analysis.
- Scientific computing: ODE solvers (RK45, BDF, LSODA), Crank–Nicolson finite differences, sparse finite elements, nonlinear least squares, constrained optimisation, convergence and stability analysis (MMS, Richardson, von Neumann/CFL).
- Statistical programming: maximum likelihood and Bayesian inference, GLMs, survival analysis, bootstrap intervals, FDR control, Monte Carlo, Markov chains and HMMs, identifiability and Sobol sensitivity.
- Spatial data analysis: Moran's I, kernel density estimation, IDW and kriging, point-pattern analysis, Laplacian/gradient operators, disease mapping.
- Systems engineering: EARS requirements, V-model and traceability, FMEA and ISO 14971-style risk analysis, ADRs and ICDs, state-space and PID control, Kalman filtering, queueing and system dynamics.
- Bioinformatics algorithms: dynamic-programming alignment, de Bruijn graph assembly, BWT/FM-index, profile HMMs and PSSMs, phylogenetics, AlphaFold and ESM-2.

## Skills

Python, TypeScript, SQL, Bash; Nextflow, Snakemake, BioPython, variant calling, GIAB benchmarking; LLM applications, RAG, multi-agent systems, AI evaluation, Keras; FastAPI, Django, Node.js, React, Next.js; Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Google Cloud, IBM Cloud; MATLAB/Octave; data annotation (audio, medical image, clinical text); study design, biostatistics, evidence synthesis, scientific writing.
